functions.name: client_connect
functions.brief: Run the TLS 1.3 handshake as a client over connected fd fd, requesting server_name via SNI and authenticating the server as described in tls.hpp.

params.name: server_name
params.desc: the hostname for SNI and (future) certificate name checks.

functions.returns: a session handle (>= 1), or -1 on failure (see last_error()).

tags.complexity: one network round trip + O(handshake bytes) crypto.

functions.name: close
functions.brief: Send close_notify and forget the session (the TCP fd stays open and is the caller's).
functions.returns: 0 on success, -1 for an unknown session.

tags.complexity: O(log n) session-table lookup + a close_notify write.
tags.alloc: a small close_notify record (when the session is still open).

functions.name: last_error
functions.brief: The most recent tls error message on this thread ("" when none).
functions.returns: the last error text set on the calling thread, or "" if none.

functions.name: open
functions.brief: Run the TLS 1.3 client handshake over connected fd fd and return an owning Conn (the RAII, with-friendly form of client_connect()).

params.name: server_name
params.desc: the hostname for SNI and certificate name checks.

functions.returns: an owning Conn; on handshake failure its is_open() is false (see last_error()).

tags.complexity: one network round trip + O(handshake bytes) crypto.

functions.name: recv
functions.signature: recv(long long session, long long bufsize)
functions.brief: Receive and decrypt application data (one record's worth, up to bufsize bytes are returned per call; the remainder is buffered).

params.name: bufsize
params.desc: the maximum number of plaintext bytes to return this call.

functions.returns: the decrypted plaintext (up to bufsize bytes), or "" on clean close/EOF/error.

functions.name: send
functions.brief: Encrypt and send data as TLS application data.

params.name: data
params.desc: the plaintext to encrypt and transmit.

functions.name: shutdown
functions.brief: Wake a reader blocked in recv() on session WITHOUT closing/erasing it (the socket is half-closed so the blocking recv returns EOF).

params.name: session
params.desc: the session whose blocked reader should be woken.

functions.returns: 0 on success, -1 for an unknown session or a syscall error.

functions.name: close
functions.brief: Close the connection: send a close frame, then tear down TLS and the socket.

tags.alloc: a small close frame (when still open).

functions.name: connect
functions.signature: connect(const std::string &host, long long port, const std::string &path, const std::string &server_name)
functions.brief: Open a secure WebSocket connection: TCP connect, TLS 1.3 handshake, then the RFC 6455 upgrade handshake (a Sec-WebSocket-Key from the OS CSPRNG; the server's 101 Switching Protocols is required).

tags.complexity: one TCP + one TLS handshake + one HTTP round trip.
tags.alloc: the session (its reused read buffer is reserved here).

functions.name: connect_url
functions.brief: Connect from a wss://host[:port]/path URL (convenience over connect()).

functions.name: open
functions.signature: open(const std::string &host, long long port, const std::string &path, const std::string &server_name)
functions.brief: Open a secure WebSocket connection and return it as an owning Client (the RAII, with-friendly form of connect()).

tags.complexity: one TCP + one TLS handshake + one HTTP round trip.

functions.name: open_url
functions.brief: Open a secure WebSocket connection from a wss://host[:port]/path URL and return it as an owning Client (the RAII, with-friendly form of connect_url()).

functions.name: recv
functions.brief: Receive the next application message (text or binary), returned as bytes.
functions.returns: the message payload; an EMPTY string once the peer has closed.

tags.complexity: O(message length); server frames are unmasked so no XOR is done.
tags.alloc: the returned payload (one copy out of the reused read buffer).

functions.name: send_text
functions.brief: Send one application TEXT message as a single masked frame (clients MUST mask, RFC 6455 §5.3; the 4-byte key is drawn from the OS CSPRNG).
functions.returns: the number of payload bytes sent.

tags.complexity: O(message length) (a 64-bit-word XOR mask + one TLS write).
tags.alloc: one frame buffer sized to the message.

functions.name: shutdown
functions.brief: Wake a reader blocked in recv() on session WITHOUT freeing it (half-closes the socket so recv returns "").

params.name: session
params.desc: the session whose blocked reader should be woken.

functions.returns: 0 on success, -1 for an unknown session or a syscall error.

functions.name: x25519
functions.brief: The X25519 function: scalar-multiply point_hex (a u-coordinate) by scalar_hex.
functions.returns: the 32-byte result as 64-char hex, or "" on malformed input or an all-zero result (a contributory-behaviour check: a zero shared secret is REJECTED).

functions.name: x25519_base
functions.brief: The base-point form: derive the public key for scalar_hex (u = 9).
functions.returns: the public key as 64-char hex, or "" on malformed input.
